name: IEM congressional control market: probability Democrats control the US House (chained)
source: Iowa Electronic Markets (University of Iowa Tippie College of Business) price histories
units: cumulative change in implied probability, percentage points (chained across cycles)
notes: From the combined Congressional Control markets (outcomes House x Senate: DH/RH x DS/RS; through 2006 and late Oct 2010 coded N = non-Republican, i.e. Democrats plus independents). Value = sum of last prices of outcomes with that chamber Democratic over the sum of the four named outcomes; the 2012+ OTHER contract is excluded (it traded erratically, 0.2-0.4 in 2023-24). Days kept only if every named outcome has traded at least once and their last prices sum to 0.85-1.2 (drops early days with untraded outcomes and incoherent thin-market days; election-night settlement moves are kept). The 2020 market's last trade (2021-01-04) predates the Georgia runoffs. Uses the source last prices on days with at least one trade, so some components can be stale. No 2014 market history is published. The separate House/Senate markets are gain/hold/lose ladders and are not used. Cycles chained (cross-cycle jumps removed): 2002 2002-07-19..2002-11-07 (p 0.45->0.00); 2004 2004-06-18..2004-11-05 (p 0.22->0.00); 2006 2006-06-01..2006-11-12 (p 0.53->1.00); 2008 2008-08-24..2008-11-04 (p 0.99->0.97); 2010 2009-12-01..2010-11-04 (p 0.89->0.00); 2012 2011-07-16..2012-11-07 (p 0.31->0.00); 2016 2014-11-22..2016-11-10 (p 0.10->0.00); 2018 2016-12-24..2018-11-11 (p 0.10->1.00); 2020 2019-02-11..2020-12-17 (p 0.84->1.00); 2022 2021-02-27..2022-11-08 (p 0.83->0.19); 2024 2023-10-18..2024-11-21 (p 0.71->0.00); 2026 2025-12-22..2026-10-17 (p 0.73->0.87). Days with no trade in the relevant contracts are left out (thin, small-stakes market; many gaps). Last price = last trade before midnight Central, hence known_after_days=1.

name: IEM presidential vote-share market: expected Democratic share of the two-party vote (chained)
source: Iowa Electronic Markets (University of Iowa Tippie College of Business) price histories
units: cumulative change in expected Democratic two-party vote share, percentage points (chained across cycles)
notes: VS contracts pay the nominee share of the two-party vote (2000: three-party with Reform, converted to Dem/(Dem+Rep)). 2004 omitted: that market traded nominee-specific contracts (KERR, DEAN, BU|KERR, ...). Prints outside 0.35-0.65 dropped as implausible thin-market trades (e.g. a 1.00 first print in 2019). name: IEM presidential winner-take-all market: Democratic popular-vote win probability (chained)
source: Iowa Electronic Markets (University of Iowa Tippie College of Business) price histories
units: cumulative change in implied probability, percentage points (chained across cycles)
notes: Contracts DEM/REP (2000: Dem/Rep; 2004: DEM04/REP04 - the G52/L52 vote-band contracts are ignored). name: Violent conflict events per day in Israel and the Palestinian territories (ICEWS, CAMEO roots 18-20)
source: ICEWS Coded Event Data (Lockheed Martin / Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/28075)
units: events per day
notes: Event location Israel + Occupied Palestinian Territory. Machine-coded (CAMEO) events from international news wires, located by event location (Country field). Ends 2023-04-09 (ICEWS discontinued; last file day 2023-04-10 incomplete and dropped). Coverage changes: yearly volumes shift with the source set (notably the 2014 production change and a dip in 2020); event IDs de-duplicated across files. Events were reported in the news on/after the day; the dataset itself was published with a lag (before v23 in 2018 the latest year was withheld), so known_after_days=1 is information timing, not vintage availability.
